title: Epic Eats Restaurant at Disney's Hollywood Studios | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Epic Eats Located in Echo Lake at Disney's Hollywood Studios This Indiana Jones-style desert canteen may look ramshackle and rusty… but it’s a trusted tabernacle for travelers hankering for beverages and signature sweet treats—including funnel cakes, topped off with an assortment of tempting accoutrements.View Menu American Snack Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM Valid admission required.
